title: Tika-Taka -- All Flow, No Goals -- Arcade Style Possession Based Soccer Game in the Browser.
author: redwurm

comments.author: redwurm
comments.body:
I started this about 5 years ago in Vanilla JS and then picked it back up last month with a combo of Codex/ClaudeCode to let them finish my idea. I'm happy with it on Desktop with a game pad (which is what it was designed for originally) but I'd love some harsh constructive criticism on the mobile side (both portrait and landscape) as well as the keyboard/mouse on desktop, as its they are the ones I don't feel fully comfortable testing.  
  
Alpha Build Link --> [https://tika-taka.chris.guru](https://tika-taka.chris.guru)
